subject: Social Media
title: Regulation Is Coming
description: A quick, practical guide to Regulation Is Coming.

hook.text: France passed a law requiring influencers to label filtered photos. Break it: fines up to €300,000.

buildup.text: Countries are regulating influencer marketing fast. The UK, EU, and Australia all passed new rules.

discovery.text: Key requirements: disclose all paid content, label AI-generated images, and protect minors in content.

twist.text: Enforcement is the weak link. Millions of posts daily, a handful of regulators. Most violations go unnoticed.

climax.text: Self-regulation failed. Industry codes of conduct were ignored. Government stepped in because nobody else would.

punchline.text: When the industry won't police itself, the state does.

quiz.question: What did France require influencers to do with filtered photos?
